scientific_integrity: The proof is exhaustive because every deficient-divisor triple is one of twenty subsets of six possible divisors, and each case reduces to positive divisors of an explicit constant at most 33. The finite verifier reproduces the symbolic reduction and independently checks the six final identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only squarefree integers of the form 2*p*q with odd primes p<q. It does not classify nonsquarefree exactly 3-deficient-perfect integers or arbitrary three-prime-support cases.
title: Squarefree three-prime exactly \(3\)-deficient-perfect numbers
